contexts: health board of about 410,000 people, 58 practices
reading: The gap sits between a register that finds untreated patients and practices that do not act on it. The proposed interventions work at different points: pharmacist review and decision aids at the patient, prompts at the prescriber, practice feedback at the organisation. The recorded search found nothing, so every evidence node below is an unchecked lead; the umbrella review's task is to retrieve, check and compare them.

nodes.label: Atrial fibrillation gap register
nodes.detail: 3,960 eligible patients without an anticoagulant in August 2026.

nodes.label: Appropriate anticoagulation
nodes.detail: Eligible patient offered and, if they choose, prescribed an anticoagulant.

nodes.label: Lead: review of decision aids
nodes.detail: Unchecked lead; less decisional conflict, no consistent prescribing effect.

nodes.label: People who declined treatment
nodes.detail: An informed decline is not a gap to close.

nodes.label: Empty recorded search
nodes.detail: No record retrieved; certainty not assessed.

summary: Map of intervention levels against the gap, over an empty recorded search.
